notes: Colophon names no scribe, donor or owner. Only the reigning king is partly legible: his name is lost in a lacuna and only "-lla-deva" survives, so he is probably a Malla king, but he cannot be identified. The year is corrupt ("minarituśra"), so the era NS is assumed from the Newari context and no CE year is given. Place: Lalitabrumā (probably Lalitapura/Patan), "west of Śrāniglaka", in the Vūvahāra (Bū Bahal) vihāra. Patan is an inference, not stated outright. "vaidyaḥ" probably describes the book (vaidya-śāstra) or a vaidya named in a damaged passage. It is not clearly a person's name. The text is Siddhasārasaṃhitā with the nirghaṇṭaka. The catalogue fields are empty.
